reviewNotes: TDD caveat, recorded honestly: replay.mjs and receipt-store.mjs were implemented before their tests in the subagent's pass. The red logs are genuine failing runs (implementation moved aside, real ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND captured) but do NOT demonstrate tests written blind to the implementation. keys.mjs and receipt-auth.mjs were strict test-first.

Lane-review finding (fixed): verifyChain() could not detect a rewritten tail entry or truncated history — a forward-only hash chain has nothing linking to its newest entry, so both attacks returned ok:true. Detailed plan §5.3 explicitly forbids truncating history for a green result, so this mattered. Added a head anchor (<root>/chain-head.json) written atomically on append and re-anchored on quarantine, plus three regression tests. HONEST LIMIT documented in code: the anchor shares the store's ownership, so it raises the bar against accidental truncation and careless tampering but is not a defence against the same-user adversary KEY-CUSTODY.md already places out of scope.

Documented limitation retained from the subagent: after quarantine(), verifyChain() does not re-validate chain continuity across the tombstone boundary (doing so would require rewriting appended history). It resumes strict verification immediately after the tombstone.

findingsClosed: S00 finding 5 — authority='host' is necessary but never sufficient. A receipt must be a structurally valid S03 auth envelope AND verify under verifyRecord over HOST_EVENT_BOUND_FIELDS; the bare non-empty string Forge accepted is refused before verifyRecord is even reached. The only alternative path is an explicit connectionTrust assertion, which downgrades the receipt to host-connection-trust + perMessage:false rather than granting the strength it lacks.

reviewNotes: No meaningful red log exists for this entry and none was fabricated: it is an integration test written over modules that were already green individually. Its first run did fail (a `require` in an ESM file), but that was an authoring bug in the test, not an absent implementation, so it is not TDD red evidence.

Integration bug found and fixed during this wiring: PreEffectGate passed `now` to CapabilityStore.check as epoch millis, while that method compares it against an ISO `expiresAt` with `>=`. A number-vs-string comparison is always false, so capability expiry silently never fired through the gate. Normalized at the seam and locked with a named regression test.

proposedContractAmendments.target: packages/contracts/enums.mjs EFFECT_CLASS (SEAL Q4, assigned to this lane)
proposedContractAmendments.rationale: FILE_READ is the load-bearing one: ARCHITECTURE §24a says read-only operations may continue when the gate is unavailable, but with no read class 'read-only' is not representable in an effect request, so the gate cannot distinguish what may continue from what must fail closed, and execution-contract-v1.scope.read[] has no effect class to check against. CREDENTIAL_ACCESS conflates reading a secret with rotating/revoking one, which is why the shipped bundle must deny it wholesale. PROCESS_KILL mutates live system state and is not a PROCESS_SPAWN.
proposedContractAmendments.impact: Additive only. No existing value changes meaning, so evidence bound to the current digest stays valid. effect-request-v1, effect-receipt-v1, and execution-contract-v1.authorizedEffectClasses all inline the same enum and inherit automatically.

proposedContractAmendments.proposal: Add a 7th kind 'dimension-digest' with a sibling 'dimension' field drawn from the full DEPENDENCY_DIMENSION set.
proposedContractAmendments.rationale: The detailed plan §6.2 requires 16 invalidation dimensions; the frozen enum has 6 buckets, and 9 of the 16 have no faithful projection (worktree-dirty, lockfile-version, schema-version, fixture-digest, environment, method-fingerprint, topology, approval-authority, upstream-contract-revision). The lossless triple is kept on the Arcane-side envelope today, but the receipt loses dimension precision.
proposedContractAmendments.impact: Additive. Existing 6 kinds untouched for callers that do not need dimension-level precision.

proposedContractAmendments.target: packages/contracts/enums.mjs AUTHENTICATION_METHOD (SEAL Q6, assigned to this lane)
proposedContractAmendments.proposal: Keep the three reserved values as-is: host-connection-trust | capability-signature | unauthenticated.
proposedContractAmendments.rationale: S03 designed and built the real authentication, and the three values turned out to be exactly the three states the implementation can actually be in: a verified per-message HMAC (capability-signature), inherited connection-level trust that structurally cannot claim perMessage:true (host-connection-trust), and everything legacy (unauthenticated, pinned by legacy-envelope-v1.provenance.authenticated const:false). No fourth state arose. FREEZE.md open question 6 asked for this to be treated as provisional until S03 existed — S03 now exists and confirms it.
proposedContractAmendments.impact: None. This resolves a reserved slot rather than changing it.
